LanguageData.Gun_PPSh-41s_RWP.label: PPSh-41 (Stick)
LanguageData.Gun_PPSh-41s_RWP.description: The PPSh-41 (Stick) is a rapid-firing submachine gun, originally designed in the Soviet Union during World War II. Featuring a high rate of fire and a simple design, this compact weapon is effective at short to medium range, making it a formidable choice against multiple foes in combat. Its signature stick magazine offers reliability and ease of reloading, ideal for sustained engagements on the battlefield.
